title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is a divorce issued by an English court based on false claims of separation and mutual consent valid according to Shariah? 1820 views Q. Divorce through email 3187 views Q. Annulment of marriage 7606 views Q. Because of a misunderstanding and argument, my wife repeatedly slapped me twice. I went down, spoke to her mother, and asked her help in calming her down. 3120 views Q. Assalaam-o-alaikum, This question relates to my sister's situation.My sister's husband and her inlaws have been demanding money regularly (dowry) and their hunger for money has only increased. My sister's husband now claims that my sister sms'd him (he was overseas)asking for a khula and he granted to her via sms. This is utterly baseless and untrue.They are using this ploy only to use the loopholes of khula to escape his responsibilities with regards to financial compensation if he was to give talaq.My sister has 3 year old kid from this marriage. Her husband has used "khula through sms" and since remarried. Does Islam allow Khula by sms ? what are the options we have , how do we teach him a lesson so that no one in future would play around with Islam like he has ? Thanks, Jazak Allah khair 1634 views Q. Their is Sharee-Counsil in london can they do FASAAQH of my NIKAAH in london as this country is not a muslim country if they can then please answer my question with evidence from Quraan and Sunaah if not then also give me the evidence from Quraan and Sunaah. 1800 views Q. if one divorce his wife three time befor vitness and after one year he again want to get marry with his x-wife so is it possible according to sharah or not? 2178 views Q. Assalam-Alaikum - My wife has forcefully obtained a Khula without my consent through an Imam in the USA. She has not informed any genuine reasons to the Imam, who claims that it is permissible to grant her the Khula without a reason or husband's consent. For the sake of obtaining the Khula, she came up with some false allegations against me that the Imam did not verify with me but agreed with her. She has been studying at a different city and denied me access to her during the last one year. Hence I was not given any chance of reconciliation by my wife. She has also taken away jewelry that my family had purchased for her use but as my wife. Being a only child, she has been offered unconditional support of her parents, who claim that I have spoiled their daughter's life, which is not the case. Our marriage was not 100% in order as we both expected to live in two cities and meet often to support my job and her studies. Is this Khula permitted? Can my wife take away the jewelry? Should the reasons of the Khula be shared with the husband for mutual agreement? Is the husband's consent not required at all? I am afraid that such exploitation of Islam is harmful to the institution of marriage. When asked about it, the Imam said that men also abuse their rights. This was not a good answer. Please let me know if this Khula is valid or can be revoked. I really love my wife and do not have any issues with her. I am willing to give her anything to maintain the marriage. What is the solution for this problem? Kindly respond as soon as possible as I am really worried. Jazak-Allah. 20728 views Q. I was engaged to Mushtaq Ahmad Shah and the Nikah was performed on 04-03-2004. However the marriage ceremony (on which zafaf/ Rukhsati that takes place as per custom) has not taken place till today because of the rude, cruel and inhumane behaviour of the to be husband (Mushtaq Ahmad Shah). On 18-05-04 he came to our house, beated and tortuted me mercilessly.Since then this dispute has started.On 11-08-2004 he came to the University and misbehaved with me in front of the students and teacher thus humiliating me. Keeping his treatment in view even before the actual marriage (Rukhsati etc), I along with my parents feel that this union will not be of any happiness rather will be full of miseries and problems. Also I fear that I will not be able to obey him properly and indulge in gunah. I approached directly and indirectly (through various Islamic Institutions i.e, Darul Uloom) to him for talaaq/khulah so that I would get free from his clutches. However he is neither giving talaaq nor compromising for khulah. Instead he threatens that he will neither give talaq nor khulah till life. Due to his bad and mischievious treatment, he has not only hurt me physically but also mentally/psychologically and undoubtedly it is not possible for me to live a happy and peaceful married life with him in future. As such it is requested please guide me in the light of Shariah regarding following point. 1. What I can do if that rude and rough person is not ready to give talaaq nor is compromising for khulah. 2. Under such conditions, what action can I take to get rid of him. What are the various options and implications? 3. It may be noted that presently I am doing PhD at University of Kashmir and am of the age 32 years and am wholly and solely dependent on my aged parents. I have no personal income or assets. (It may be mentioned that Mushtaq Ahmad Shah is not responding to the various Darul Fatwas directives. As such it is requested under such conditions what are the ways for legal separation from him according to Shariat Laws.) 1805 views Q. Talaq 1876 views Q. I got married as per Sharia Laws on 25th February 2010.. My wife is about 4 months pregnant & we were living very happily together.. Suddenly on 12th June 2010 my wife left her matrimonial house & went to her parents house.. The next day she said she does not want to continue the marriage & she wants a Talaaq.. I dont want to give her Talaaq as i dont have any problem with her & im also worried about the future of my child who has still not come to this world.. Now her parents are saying they will send Khula Notice.. What should i do to save this marriage & also the future of my child. 1765 views Q. asslamoalaykum I gave one talaq to my wife by post. She is in india and I m in Australia. now we have realised our mistakes and want to reconcile. I had also sent the mehaer to my wife through western union money transfer but she did not accept it so the money is still with me, now the iddat period will be over in 3-4 weeks. So what will be the procedure to revoke the talaq. Can I revoke it by post? My problem is, I may not be able to go to India before the iddat period gets over. So what will be the procedure to revoke the talaq after the iddat period is over? We will have to perform NIKAH again? Please guide us in this matter as soon as possible. Allah hafiz. 4338 views Q. How to get divorce when the woman is pregnan 2118 views Q. If a man says to his wife 3 times in one go, talaq is this will be talaq? 2854 views Q. I want to ask that last night I and my wife had fight? I was asking her to keep quite but she was still continuing shouting on me. Then in anger I took Quran in my hand say 1 time talaq and said if for 1 month she do not stay with me as per my wish then I will give her second or final talq Please advice? 2497 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 37898 Country: India Title: Question regarding validity of Talaaq and Ruju after khula/talaq. Question: I got married in 2010. After marriage I came to know that the girl was having a disease which I did not know. She also had habit of gutkha. She also told me some lies about her education and family's education. When I asked her why she lied and hidden things, she got angry and started fighting. She used to go to her brother's house which was near. Many a times her brother got involved and arranged a patch up. I also agreed as I thought about society and 'family's honor'. She always asked me to give her divorce and I always tried to calm her down. My Point: in our last 3 meetings, when she asked me, I said in Urdu/Hindi 'because you are asking me for this, I give you talaq' and she left my house. There was gap of 1-2 months or so between 3 talaqs and no physical contact. This happened in 2010 only. Now she wants to come back. Is it possible now, I do not want halalah also? And, I will not go against Islam. Please advice. Answer ID: 37898 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 95/93/N=1433) Your question shows that you have had special meeting or privacy with your wife after marriage and you have given her three talaqs. If the case is so and you have given second and third talaq before completing iddah then in the question mentioned above all the three talaqs took place on your wife and she became haram completely for you. Now without a valid halalah she cannot come in your marital relation. Almighty Allah says in the holy Quran: فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلاَ تَحِلُّ لَهُ مِن بَعْدُ حَتَّىَ تَنكِحَ زَوْجاً غَيْرَهُ [البقرة : 230] وقال فى الفتاوى الهندية (كتاب الطلاق باب فى الرجعة فصل في ما تحل به المطلقة وما يتصل به 1 : 506) : وإن كان الطلاق ثلاثا فى الحرة .... لم تحل له حتى تنكح زوجا غيره نكاحا صحيحا ويدخل بها ثم يطلقها أو يموت عنها كذا فى الهداية اهـ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
